protocols.condition: Sleep debt > 4.5 hrs OR Circadian phase shift > 2.0 hrs
protocols.title: NASA Blue-Enriched Phototherapy & Chronobiological Resequencing
protocols.clinical_action: Prescribe 10,000-lux blue-enriched (460-480nm) light therapy for 45 minutes immediately upon waking (06:00-06:45 UTC). Restrict caffeine 6 hours prior to sleep. Enforce a 60-minute sleep sanctuary blackout protocol.
protocols.operational_impact: Postpone high-risk EVA operations by 24 hours. Delegate manual robotics to secondary crew member.

protocols.condition: Ambient CO2 > 4500 ppm OR SpO2 < 93% with elevated resting HR
protocols.title: ECLSS Carbon Dioxide Scrubbing Override & Acute Oxygen Enrichment
protocols.clinical_action: Initiate auxiliary Amine Swing Bed (ASB) scrubber cycling. Increase cabin ventilation blower to 120% nominal. Administer supplemental 28% O2 via nasal cannula for 30 minutes if headache reported.
protocols.operational_impact: Hold physical resistive exercise in module until ambient CO2 stabilizes below 3000 ppm.
citations: Law et al., J. Occup. Environ. Med. 2014

protocols.condition: Daily Radiation Flux > 10.0 mGy/day OR Active Solar Particle Event (SPE)
protocols.title: Storm Shelter Emergency Ingress & Pharmacological Radioprotection
protocols.clinical_action: Immediate termination of all EVA activities. Ingress into central water-wall reinforced radiation storm shelter. Initiate oral antioxidant / radioprotective micronutrient regimen (alpha-tocopherol, selenium, NAC).
protocols.operational_impact: All external payload maintenance halted. Continuous active dosimeter monitoring engaged.
citations: NASA Space Radiation Cancer Risk Model (NSCR-2020)
Cucinotta et al., Life Sci Space Res 2017

protocols.condition: HRV RMSSD < 25 ms AND Resting HR > 25% above baseline
protocols.title: Autonomic Tone Recovery & Fluid Loading Protocol
protocols.clinical_action: Prescribe 1.0 L electrolyte isotonic fluid rehydration with 0.9g sodium chloride equivalent. Prescribe 20 minutes structured biofeedback diaphragmatic breathing at 0.1 Hz resonance frequency.
protocols.operational_impact: Downscale high-g maneuver readiness. Re-evaluate blood pressure profile.
citations: Hughson et al., J. Appl. Physiol 2016
